task.description:
Implement OIDC-16 through OIDC-26 per the provided design artefacts. Keep implementation in backend scope (Zig + migrations + tests) and maintain Stage 6.5 conventions.

Mandatory validations before completion:
- zig build
- zig build test
- zig build migrate
- zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set'  (must produce no output)

Requirements focus:
- Agent lifecycle APIs and scoped auth (OIDC-16)
- Provisioning idempotency and transactional compensation (OIDC-17/18)
- Provisioning audit with redaction (OIDC-19)
- Agent service accounts, token rotation, bootstrap identity (OIDC-20/21/22)
- Federation support + attribute mapping (OIDC-23/24)
- Provider readiness and metrics exposure (OIDC-25/26)

When done, commit and push implementation to feature/WF02-oidc16-26-20260528 per BACKEND-DEV protocol.
acceptance_criteria: All OIDC-16..26 MUST requirements implemented (OIDC-24 SHOULD included where feasible)

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-16 through OIDC-26 backend foundations: lifecycle/idempotency/transaction/audit-redaction/bootstrap/federation-mapping module, provider readiness integration, provider metrics, OpenAPI lifecycle routes, and schema migrations.
